description: South Korea acquisition tax when buying a home: 1-3% by price (sliding rate between 600M and 900M), 8%/12% heavy rates for multiple homes and corporations, plus local education tax and rural special tax, and the first-home relief of up to 2M.

areaOver85sqm.description: Exclusive area over 85 m2 (rural special tax applies); default false

corporation.description: Buyer is a corporation (12%); default false

firstHome.description: First home ever for the household, price up to 1.2B (relief up to 2M of acquisition tax; surtax adjustments not modeled); default false

homesAfterPurchase.description: Homes the household owns including this one; default 1

regulatedArea.description: Home is in an adjustment-target area (jojeong daesang jiyeok), where heavy rates start from the 2nd home; default false

name: housing_acquisition_tax
